meta.title: Official document formatting
meta.description: Auto-apply the general official document format to every generated .docx.

title: Docx format
skipped: skipped (no trigger keyword, global normalization off)
skipReason: official-document formatting not applied (no trigger keyword)
lightApplied: global normalization only (no 公文 in the request: pagination switches, Chinese quotes, no space around Latin words)

config.triggerKeywords: trigger words; the request text must contain one of them for the full layout, default ['公文']
config.globalNormalize: still apply global normalization when no trigger word matched (pagination off, Chinese quotes, no CJK-Latin spacing)
config.autoFormat: queue any .docx path seen in tool results
config.formatExisting: also normalize files created before the plugin loaded
